Team —

We're two business days out from the QBR rehearsal. Please use the attached scoring template to enter your final objective/component scores and a 2–3 sentence annotated vignette for any objective where the score changed from your working draft. Those vignettes should:
- state the concrete evidence (metric, customer example, or rollout milestone)
- call out any regression risk we should surface in the readout
- propose an ask or decision if one is needed at execs

Attachments: okrs-scoring-template.xlsx (sheet per objective), evidence-bucket-list.zip (supporting excerpts only).

Deadline: EOD Thursday (2026-11-19) so I can stitch into the QBR deck and send the exec script to Claire. If you won't hit that deadline, reply with which objectives will be delayed.

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas —

Uploaded my sheet and a short PDF with 3 annotated vignettes (see attachment names below). Quick notes:
- Growth / API adoption: final score 7/10. Evidence: launched referral program on 11/05, 4 pilot customers added (see evidence excerpts). Risk: runway vs. churn still present; ask: pilot extension approval to maintain momentum.
- Reliability / SLOs: final score 8/10. Evidence: P99 improved after kernel tweak; one customer incident in Oct (log attached) — surfaced as a brief footnote.
- Optimize toolkit: final score 6/10 — delayed rollout of quantization profiles impacted forecasted unit-cost savings.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Final OKR scoring + annotated vignettes for QBR readout

Thanks Marissa — quick reaction and a suggested adjustment.

On the Reliability objective: I'm comfortable with an 8/10 baseline, but we should normalize the scale across infra and product. The incident in October was operational and shouldn't be weighted equally with feature-delivery misses. Proposal: split the objective into "Platform Reliability" (ops metrics) and "Runtime Stability" (serving regressions) for the final readout, and present a blended score plus the separate components in the appendix. That avoids inflating the perception that product delivery hit SLOs.

Also: for Optimize toolkit, we need to call out the mitigation plan — two-week spike to rebaseline quant profiles and an ask for 0.5 FTE contractor to accelerate the rollout. If we ask for resources, flag it explicitly in the exec script.

I'll attach my consolidated notes (vivek-notes.txt) and a short reconciliation of scoring (vivek-reconcile.xlsx).

Vivek
VP, Engineering

Subject: Consolidated scoring, exec script, and rehearsal plan (final)

Appended below is the consolidated outcome and the short exec script I'll run in the QBR. I merged your scores and kept the separate component notes in the appendix (drive link). See attached: annotated-vignettes.pdf, qbr-exec-script.txt.

Consolidated outcomes (high level):
- Overall trend: Moderately positive. 6 objectives at 7+; 3 objectives needing targeted remediation (Optimize toolkit, ARR ramp, a single security artifact).
- Major asks: 0.5 FTE contractor for quant rollout; approval to extend two pilot contracts for Growth; confirm Dedicated retention SLA for one enterprise customer.
- Escalations: None blocking delivery of product roadmap; operational follow-through required on one outstanding SOC evidence item (Laura to coordinate).

QBR exec script (snippet):
"We've made tangible progress on throughput and reliability, which gives us runway to prioritize cost optimizations. That said, a focused resourcing ask (half FTE) will materially change our rollout timing for quantization profiles and preserve expected unit-cost savings."

Rehearsal plan: 11/24 10:00–11:00 PT. Claire, can you join for the first 10 minutes to align on tone? Mike (Acme Health) — invited as a stakeholder for the customer vignette section.

Attachments in mailbox: okrs-scoring-template.xlsx, annotated-vignettes.pdf, evidence-bucket-list.zip, qbr-exec-script.txt

Next steps: Laura to close SOC evidence item and confirm SLA language; Marissa to prepare a 1-slide customer impact summary; Vivek to draft the mitigation spike plan and contractor scope. I'll stitch the QBR deck and circulate by Monday morning.

—Jonas
